Package co.edu.unbosque.model

package co.edu.unbosque.model
This package contains the main classes that represent the data model of the system. data model of the system. These classes encapsulate the logic related to equipment management, units and items, as well as the access facade to the data model. Main classes: - ModelFacade: Implements the Singleton pattern and acts as a facade to manage the access to operations on DAOs and application data. - EquipoDTO: Represents an in-game team, which contains a list of assigned * units. assigned. - UnidadDTO: Represents an in-game unit, with attributes such as life, attack, defense, * experience and type, experience and type. - PartidaDTO: Represents a game game in the game, including the name, number of players, and the arrays containing both panels and units in the game. - TurnosDTO: This class is about game turns, including the history of positions, the count of turns, the current turn, the number of moves in a turn, and the number of players. This package is fundamental to the structure of the game, as it defines the core entities * and provides the structure for managing the game. and provides the structure to manage operations on them.
